WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) ns
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 1 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1,2,3
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) cs
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 1 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1,2,3
),
sw AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, st.store_name, st.open_date, st.close_date, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week,
      (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.fiscal_week_start_date)
      AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.fiscal_week_end_date)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date <= d.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= d.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_period=1 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')) d
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
)
SELECT ty.store_id, ty.store_name, ty.open_date, ty.close_date, ty.fiscal_week,
  ty.trading ty_trading, ly.trading ly_trading,
  COALESCE(a.ns,0) ty_sales, COALESCE(b.ns,0) ly_sales, COALESCE(ca.cs,0) ty_ctl, COALESCE(cb.cs,0) ly_ctl
FROM sw ty JOIN sw ly ON ly.store_id=ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week=ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'
LEFT JOIN sales a ON a.store_id=ty.store_id AND a.fiscal_week=ty.fiscal_week AND a.fiscal_year='FY2026/27'
LEFT JOIN sales b ON b.store_id=ty.store_id AND b.fiscal_week=ty.fiscal_week AND b.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'
LEFT JOIN ctl ca ON ca.store_id=ty.store_id AND ca.fiscal_week=ty.fiscal_week AND ca.fiscal_year='FY2026/27'
LEFT JOIN ctl cb ON cb.store_id=ty.store_id AND cb.fiscal_week=ty.fiscal_week AND cb.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year='FY2026/27'
  AND (NOT (ty.trading AND ly.trading) OR ABS(COALESCE(a.ns,0)-COALESCE(ca.cs,0))>1 OR ABS(COALESCE(b.ns,0)-COALESCE(cb.cs,0))>1 OR ty.store_id IN (136,137))
ORDER BY 1,5

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week,
      (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.fiscal_week_start_date)
      AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.fiscal_week_end_date)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date <= d.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= d.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date
                WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND fiscal_period = 1) d
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= DATE '2026-05-04' - 364)
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) stores
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 1
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS fiscal_period, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct, ty.stores, ly.stores, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lfl_store_weeks) sw
FROM lfl_sales ty, lfl_sales ly WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
